summary: 3701 converts the local-test gates into a source matrix. Public anchors now exist for R10/Newton, Cassini PPN gamma, MICROSCOPE WEP, NIST fine-structure alpha, and optical-clock redshift. These are deliberately nonclaim rows: they provide external normalizers and anchors, while MTS-side rho_i, z2_bound, Kperp, q_loc, full R10 curve, EM/Poynting residual tensors, and orbital kernels remain missing.
